units.source_text: 据说，从前到了撤下厚厚的雪帘、冰融雪化的初春时分，绉纱就开始上市了。

en.t: It is said that in the old days, when the thick snow screens were taken down and the ice and snow melted in early spring, chijimi crepe began to appear at market.

units.source_text: 三大城市［指东京、大阪、京都］的布庄老板也从老远赶来买绉纱，村里甚至为他们准备了长住的客栈。

en.t: Cloth merchants from the three great cities [Tokyo, Osaka, and Kyoto] came from far away to buy chijimi crepe, and the village even had inns ready for their long stays.

units.source_text: 姑娘们用半年心血把绉纱织好，也是为了这首次上市。

en.t: The girls spent half a year of devoted labor weaving the chijimi crepe, all for this first market.

units.source_text: 远近村庄的男男女女都聚拢到这儿来了。

en.t: Men and women from villages near and far all gathered here.

units.source_text: 这儿摆满了杂耍场和杂货摊，就像镇上过节一样，热闹异常。

en.t: The place was filled with sideshow booths and stalls selling sundries, bustling like a town festival.

units.source_text: 绉纱上都系有一张记着纺织姑娘的姓名和地址的纸牌，根据成绩来评定等级。

en.t: Each piece of chijimi crepe had a paper tag tied to it with the weaving girl's name and address, and it was graded according to the quality of the work.

units.source_text: 这也成为选媳妇的依据。

en.t: This also became a basis for choosing a bride.

units.source_text: 要不是从小开始学纺织，就是到了十五六岁乃至二十四五岁也是织不出优质绉纱的。

en.t: Unless a girl had begun learning to weave in childhood, she could not produce fine chijimi crepe even at fifteen or sixteen, or even at twenty-four or twenty-five.

units.source_text: 人一上岁数，织出来的布面也失去了光泽。

en.t: Once a person grew older, the surface of the cloth she wove lost its sheen.

units.source_text: 也许姑娘们为了挤进第一流纺织女工的行列而努力锻炼技能的缘故吧，

en.t: Perhaps it was because the girls worked hard to hone their skills so they could enter the ranks of first-rate weavers,

units.source_text: 她们从旧历十月开始缫丝，到翌年二月中旬晾晒完毕，

en.t: starting to reel silk in the tenth month of the old calendar and finishing the bleaching and drying by the middle of the following February,

units.source_text: 在这段冰封雪冻的日子里，别无他事可做，所以手工特别精细，

en.t: and because during those icebound, snowbound days there was nothing else to do, their handwork became especially fine,

units.source_text: 把挚爱之情全部倾注在产品上。

en.t: pouring all their affection into what they made.

units.source_text: 在岛村穿的绉纱中，说不定还有江户末期到明治初期的姑娘织的吧。

en.t: Among the chijimi crepe that Shimamura wore, there may even have been pieces woven by girls from the end of the Edo period to the beginning of the Meiji era.
